import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check package.json is actually updated
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep type /opt/areloria/package.json | head -2")
print("package.json content:", stdout.read().decode())
# Clean and rebuild
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && rm -rf server/dist node_modules/.cache && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -15")
print("\nClean rebuild:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check dist file
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -3 /opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js")
print("\nDist start:", stdout.read().decode())
# Run
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && timeout 5 node server/dist/index.js 2>&1 || true")
print("\n=== Run ===")
print(stdout.read().decode()[:500])
client.close()
EOF
